title: What's New: AL Language (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Mask Type, Document Extended Data Type, and Code Cup Rules
Sequential GUID, Data Transfer Objects, Text Constants, and Record ID
Namespace Support and External Business Events
AI Test Type and Cancellation Token in VS Code

features.name: Allowing Customizations Property Updates
features.description: Extended allowing customizations property with new options: deprecated always option replaced with 'as read only', 'as read write', and new 'to be classified' option to indicate incomplete classification.
caveats: As read only behaves the same as the deprecated always option

features.name: Mask Type Property on Fields
features.description: New property on fields called mask type with options 'none' and 'concealed' to conceal data from the UI. Different from extended data type masked.
caveats: Different behavior from extended data type masked

features.name: Document Extended Data Type Option
features.description: New option called 'document' added to extended data types to indicate that media should be rendered in portrait mode for document viewing.

features.name: Code Cup Rule for Auto Format Properties
features.description: New code cup rule to enforce usage of auto format type and auto format expression properties to help models understand what kind of data goes into fields.

features.name: Summary Fact Box Control
features.description: Automatically added summary fact boxes on card, list, and document pages. Can be hidden by referencing summary system part and setting visibility to false.
caveats: Automatically added so may need to be explicitly hidden if not wanted

features.name: Report Tooltips
features.description: Ability to specify tooltips on reports that provide extra data to users. Tooltips are included in XML data for Word and Excel reports.

features.name: Truncate Method on Tables
features.description: New truncate method on tables for more performant data deletion with some limitations. Cannot be used on media tables.
caveats: Cannot be used on media tables
Has other limitations documented in documentation

features.name: Lock Timeout Duration Method
features.description: New method to set lock timeout duration to a specific number of milliseconds. Can also be set to zero to disable timeout.
caveats: Setting to zero causes indefinite waiting and is not recommended

features.name: Record Reference Field Access Methods
features.description: New methods for record references: field exists to check if a field exists and field name to access field values using field names in the fields collection.

features.name: Create Sequential GUID Method
features.description: New create sequential GUID method to generate GUIDs that are not fully random, improving performance when inserting many GUIDs in indexes.

features.name: Update Audit Fields Property on Data Transfer Objects
features.description: New update audit fields property on data transfer objects that can be set to false to prevent audit fields from being updated when using copy fields function.

features.name: Text Constant Methods
features.description: Text constants now have all text methods available that text variables have, including contains, ends with, index of and other text manipulation methods.

features.name: Record ID Formatting Enhancements
features.description: Record ID formatting enhanced with new formats. Format 2 and 9 return fully qualified names for namespaced tables. Format 0 returns table name, format 1 returns table caption with key.
caveats: Behavior differs for namespaced vs non-namespaced tables

features.name: AL Namespace Column in Metadata Tables
features.description: New AL namespace column added to metadata tables to search for and identify namespaced tables in a project.

features.name: External Business Event Deprecation
features.description: Ability to deprecate external business events. Recommended to change external display name to indicate obsolescence to external consumers.

features.name: User Control Obsolescence
features.description: Ability to obsolete user controls using existing obsolete methods and properties.

features.name: AI Test Type
features.description: New test type 'AI test' added to indicate that a test validates AI behaviors.

features.name: Required Test Isolation Property
features.description: New required test isolation property on code units to indicate to users what isolation level is needed to run the tests in that code unit.
caveats: Tests may not work if run in a different isolation level than required

features.name: Cancellation Token Propagation in VS Code
features.description: Cancellation token now propagated to the server in VS Code extension. Allows cancelling publish operations that would otherwise run indefinitely.

quotes.text: we deprecated the always option and extended it with two new as read only as read write
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the key change to the allowing customizations property for field-level customization control.

quotes.text: We have a new property on fields called mask type. The mask type has two options for now. The none and the concealed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces the new mask type property for data concealment in the UI with specific options.

quotes.text: On the extended data types, we added a new option called document. Document is intended for you to to tell the client that this
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the purpose of the new document option for extended data types in portrait rendering.

quotes.text: If you work with a lot of data here, you have now a new option to use the truncate method on tables.
quotes.why_it_matters: Announces the new truncate method as a performance optimization option for large data operations.

quotes.text: But now if you use format two or format 9, you will get the fully qualified name of a table that is namespaced.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains new record ID formatting options that support namespaced tables with fully qualified names.

quotes.text: As part of the namespace work, we also introduce the AL namespace colum in the metadata tables.
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces namespace metadata support for discovering namespaced tables in a project.

quotes.text: Here for tests, we added a new test type AI test. This is to indicate that this test is all about validating AI behaviors.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes a new test type category specifically for AI behavior validation.

quotes.text: We've now taken the cancellation token here and propagated it all the way to the server. So when I click cancel the whole operation
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes a VS Code extension improvement that resolves the issue of never-ending publish operations.

disclaimers.text: The truncate method has some limitations. Among others, you cannot use it on media tables. I recommend everyone who thinks about using it to go check out the documentation
